claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack.
claims.evidence: The witness report identifies it as a hand pallet truck with a wooden body and metal forks, but the load rating text/model on the visible tag is not clearly readable and no lifting/holding test is shown.

risks.risk: Load capacity may be less than claimed (2.5 ton not verifiable; tag/model unreadable).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the capacity rating label/plate (showing the tonnage) and/or the model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used manual pallet jack with unknown/possibly lower capacity.

risks.risk: Hydraulics may not lift smoothly or may not hold load (no functional test shown).
risks.proof: A short video lifting a pallet to working height and holding it for several seconds without dropping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working/possible weak hydraulics.

risks.risk: Forks may have hidden damage (bends, cracks, weld issues) not clearly verifiable from the photo.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of both forks along the full length, especially near welds and tips, plus underside angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential fork wear/damage.

risks.risk: Wheel/roller condition and bearing health may be poor (caster/rollers not shown).
risks.proof: Video of rolling over a flat surface and turning the handle to show smooth movement; close-ups of rollers/casters.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown wheel/roller wear.

risks.risk: Controls/valves/levers may be faulty or incomplete (no close-up of levers/valves).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the handle controls/valves and a video showing raising/lowering actions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown functionality of controls.

risks.risk: Fit with your pallets may be wrong (fork width/length not shown).
risks.proof: A tape-measure photo showing fork length and fork width (inside-to-inside) and overall dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case for compatibility (assume standard but not confirmed).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the capacity rating label/plate (showing the tonnage) and any model/serial number.
Short video: lift a loaded pallet to height and hold for several seconds (no noticeable drop).
Close-up photos of both forks (full length, tips, and weld areas) from multiple angles.
Close-up photos of rollers/casters and a video showing smooth rolling and turning.
Close-up photos of the handle controls/valves/levers, plus a video demonstrating raise/lower.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type (manual hand pallet jack with wooden body and metal forks), so it can be priced at its worst case. However, the 2.5-ton claim and working condition are not verifiable from the provided report, so pricing should assume unknown/possibly weak hydraulics and unknown capacity.
